title: 第四章 暗流第五章 夜袭第六章约定
content_zh:
夜深了。
方圆站在新宅院的院子里，仰头看着天上的月亮。
这是一座独立的二进小院，青砖灰瓦，虽然不算大，但比他之前住的那间漏雨的柴房不知道好了多少倍。院子里有一棵老槐树，枝叶繁茂，月光透过树叶的缝隙洒下来，在地上印出斑驳的光影。
三个仆从已经在院中等候，两男一女，都是方家的外门仆役，修为最高的也不过淬体二重，打杂还行，指望他们做什么大事是不用想的。
方圆扫了他们一眼，随口吩咐道：“不用跟着我，该干什么干什么去。没我的允许，任何人不得进入内院。”
“是，少爷。”三个仆从恭恭敬敬地行礼，退出了内院。
方圆走进卧室，关上门，盘膝坐在床上。
他从怀中取出今天的战利品——三枚凝气丹，三十块下品灵石，整齐地摆在面前。
凝气丹，四品丹药，是淬体境突破凝气境的关键丹药。普通淬体九重武者服用一枚，突破凝气境的概率能提高三成。而在方家这样的家族，一枚凝气丹至少要攒三年的供奉才能换到。
方圆一口气拿三枚。
但在他眼里，这玩意儿不过是垃圾。
前世身为玄帝，他炼过的丹药不计其数，从一品到九品，从丹药到仙丹，哪一种不是天材地宝炼制而成？凝气丹这种最低等的突破丹药，放在前世他连看都不看一眼。
但这一世，蚊子腿也是肉。
方圆拈起一枚凝气丹，丢进嘴里，嚼了嚼吞下。
一股温热的药力在体内化开，流向四肢百骸。普通武者服药后需要盘膝打坐，引导药力运转周天，否则药力会白白浪费大半。
方圆不需要。
他的《玄帝不灭经》霸道无比，功法运转之间，药力被血肉骨骼鲸吞般吸收，一丝一毫都没有浪费。
半刻钟后，三枚凝气丹全部入腹，三十块灵石也被他握在手中，将里面的灵气吸得干干净净。
灵石碎裂一地，化作粉末。
方圆闭目内视，观察自己身体内部的变化。

绝脉之体确实神奇。普通武者的丹田像一个水池，储存灵力；而他的丹田虽然萎缩，但他全身的血肉就是丹田。每一寸肌肉、每一块骨骼、每一条筋脉，都能储存力量。
如果说普通淬体三重的身体容量是一碗水，那他的身体容量就是一缸水。
三枚凝气丹和三十块灵石的全部药力融入体内，他的修为从淬体三重直线飙升——
淬体四重！
淬体五重！
淬体六重！
一直冲到淬体六重巅峰才停了下来。
方圆睁开眼睛，眼中精光一闪，如两道闪电劈开黑暗。
“淬体六重巅峰。”方圆捏了捏拳头，感受着体内澎湃的力量，“距离淬体七重还差半步。按照这个速度，半个月内就能突破到凝气境。”
不过他知道，淬体境只是打基础，凝气境才是真正的开始。
在天玄大陆，修炼境界分为：淬体、凝气、筑基、金丹、元婴、化神、渡劫、大乘。每一大境界又分九重小境界。
前世他修炼到了大乘九重巅峰，半只脚踏入了传说中的“帝境”，被世人尊称为“玄帝”。
这一世从头开始，他不急。万丈高楼平地起，基础打牢了，后面才能走得远。
方圆正准备继续修炼，忽然耳朵一动。
院外有脚步声。
不是仆从的脚步声——仆从走路带着卑微的急促，而这个人走路沉稳有力，每一步的间距几乎相等，是从小严格训练形成的习惯。
武者。凝气境以上。
方圆收起灵石碎屑，翻身下床，推门而出。
月光下，一个五十多岁的男子负手站在院中，一身玄色长袍，面容威严，正是方家家主方正阳。
“家主深夜来访，有何指教？”方圆站在台阶上，拱手道。

方正阳上下打量着他，目光深邃，像要把人看穿。
“淬体六重巅峰？”方正阳的眉头微微皱起，“白天你族比时还是淬体三重，现在就淬体六重巅峰了？”
他进门的那一刻就用灵识扫过方圆，结果让他大吃一惊。
方圆没有隐瞒，也隐瞒不了。在凝气九重巅峰的强者面前，他的修为就像秃子头上的虱子一样明摆着。
content_en:
It's late at night.
Fangyuan stood in the yard of the new house, looking up at the moon in the sky.
This is an independent two-story courtyard with gray bricks and gray tiles. Although it is not big, it is many times better than the leaky woodshed he lived in before. There is an old locust tree in the yard with lush branches and leaves. The moonlight shines through the gaps in the leaves, printing mottled light and shadow on the ground.
Three servants are already waiting in the courtyard, two men and one woman. They are all external servants of the Fang family. The ones with the highest cultivation level are only at the second level of body tempering. They can do odd jobs. There is no need to think about expecting them to do anything big.
Fangyuan glanced at them and casually ordered: "You don't have to follow me, just do whatever you need to do. No one is allowed to enter the inner courtyard without my permission."
"Yes, Master." The three servants saluted respectfully and exited the inner courtyard.
Fangyuan walked into the bedroom, closed the door, and sat cross-legged on the bed.
He took out today's spoils from his arms - three Qi Condensing Pills and thirty low-grade spiritual stones, and placed them neatly in front of him.
Qi Condensing Pill, a fourth-grade elixir, is the key pill for the Body Tempering Realm to break through the Qi Condensing Realm. If an ordinary ninth-level body-tempering warrior takes one, the probability of breaking through the Qi Condensation Realm can be increased by 30%. In a family like the Fang family, it would take at least three years of sacrifices to exchange for a Qi Condensing Pill.
Fangyuan took three in one breath.
But in his eyes, this thing is just garbage.
As Emperor Xuan in his previous life, he had refined countless elixirs, from first-grade to ninth-grade pills, from elixirs to elixirs, which one was not made from heavenly materials and earthly treasures? In his previous life, he wouldn't even have looked at the lowest level of breakthrough elixir, the Qi Condensing Pill.
But in this life, mosquito legs are also meat.
Fangyuan picked up a Qi Condensing Pill, threw it into his mouth, chewed it and swallowed it.
A warm medicinal power melted in the body and flowed to the limbs and bones. Ordinary warriors need to sit cross-legged and meditate after taking medicine to guide the medicine's power to circulate throughout the sky, otherwise most of the medicine's power will be wasted.
Fangyuan doesn't need it.
His "Xuan Emperor's Immortal Sutra" is extremely domineering. During the operation of the technique, the power of the medicine is absorbed by the flesh and bones like a whale, without wasting any of it.
Half a quarter of an hour later, all three Qi Condensing Pills entered his abdomen, and thirty spiritual stones were also held in his hands, sucking out the spiritual energy inside.
The spirit stone shattered on the ground and turned into powder.
Fangyuan closed her eyes and looked inside, observing the changes inside her body.
The Juemian body is truly magical. The Dantian of an ordinary warrior is like a pool, storing spiritual power; and although his Dantian has shrunk, the flesh and blood of his body is the Dantian. Every inch of muscle, every bone, and every sinew can store strength.
If the body capacity of an ordinary third-level body quenching is a bowl of water, then his body capacity is a tank of water.
All the medicinal power of the three Qi Condensing Pills and thirty spirit stones were integrated into his body, and his cultivation soared straight from the third level of body tempering——
The fourth level of body tempering!
Fifth level of body tempering!
Sixth level of body tempering!
He rushed to the peak of the sixth level of body tempering before stopping.
Fang Yuan opened his eyes, and there was a flash of light in his eyes, like two bolts of lightning splitting the darkness.
"The peak of the sixth level of Body Tempering." Fang Yuan clenched his fists, feeling the surging power in his body, "We are still half a step away from the seventh level of Body Tempering. At this rate, we can break through to the Qi Condensation Realm within half a month."
However, he knew that the body-tempering realm was just the foundation, and the Qi-condensing realm was the real beginning.
In Tianxuan Continent, the cultivation realms are divided into: body tempering, qi condensation, foundation building, golden elixir, Yuanying, transformation into gods, transcending tribulations, and Mahayana. Each major realm is divided into nine smaller realms.
In his previous life, he had reached the peak of the ninth level of Mahayana, half-stepped into the legendary "Emperor Realm", and was revered as "Xuan Emperor" by the world.
He is not in a hurry to start this life from scratch. Tall buildings rise from the ground, and only by laying a solid foundation can we go far.
Fangyuan was about to continue practicing when his ears suddenly twitched.
There were footsteps outside the hospital.
It wasn't the footsteps of a servant - the servant walked with a humble haste, but this man walked steadily and powerfully, with almost equal intervals between steps.A habit formed through rigorous training.
Warrior. Above the Qi Condensation Realm.
Fangyuan collected the spirit stone fragments, got out of bed, and pushed out the door.
Under the moonlight, a man in his fifties stood in the courtyard with his hands behind his hands. He was dressed in a black robe and had a majestic face. He was Fang Zhengyang, the head of the Fang family.
"The master of the house is here late at night, what advice do you have?" Fang Yuan stood on the steps and asked with cupped hands.
Fang Zhengyang looked him up and down with a deep gaze, as if he wanted to see through people.
"The peak of the sixth level of Body Tempering?" Fang Zhengyang frowned slightly, "During the day, your clan was still at the third level of Body Tempering, but now you are at the peak of the Sixth Level of Body Tempering?"
The moment he entered, he scanned the surrounding area with his spiritual consciousness, and the result surprised him.
Fangyuan didn't hide anything, and couldn't hide it. In front of a strong man at the ninth level of Qi Condensation, his cultivation was as obvious as the lice on a bald man's head.
